title: Clear words and a changing response
meaning: You can openly explain a personal understanding and keep warmth in conversation even when feelings about what was heard change.
text: On your Vishuddha, clarity of words need not make feelings stand still. The Hermit in the physical position helps explain a personal understanding reached through reflection. The Sun in energy supports a wish to speak openly and warmly rather than leave the main point in hints. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings a changing response: the same answer may first please you and later bring regret. The meaning of the words can stay understandable while the experience is still changing.

For example, you discuss the admission “Sometimes it is easier for me to write something important than say it straight away”. You explain that writing helps gather a thought rather than replace every spoken conversation. **A clear answer does not require an unchanging feeling**. At first the possibility brings relief; later, sadness about an anticipated face-to-face conversation may appear. Both responses concern the same explanation and need not cancel willingness to hear each other in writing. Openness allows you to name the convenience and what still feels missing.

The risk appears when a considered explanation becomes a reason never to revisit feelings. A changing response then seems inconsistent although the answer itself has not changed. The Sun’s constructive warmth helps keep conversation available. You can hear an altered experience again without requiring fresh proof of every phrase’s meaning: an emotional turn does not always mean a new disagreement about the agreement.
